name.zh: 东吁 · 勃固宫廷区域参照

note.en: The older 1500 Pegu outline is reused in 1569–1598 only to orient the lower-Burma court region of the Toungoo dynasty. The Smithsonian dates the capital’s move to Pegu to 1539 and its occupation by Arakan to 1599. This is not the full Toungoo empire, an occupation boundary in Siam, or proof of uniform rule. Ayutthaya is separately shown as a subordinate court, with its own older source outline and disputed restoration dates.
note.zh: 复用较早的1500年勃固轮廓，仅为1569—1598年东吁王朝下缅甸宫廷地区提供定位。史密森将迁都勃固定于1539年，并将阿拉干占领勃固定于1599年。此轮廓并非完整东吁帝国、暹罗境内的占领边界或均匀统治的证据。阿瑜陀耶宫廷另行表示，并保留较早来源轮廓及复国年代争议。
